newsitem.title: USA: Another body found from July 17 TWA crash.
newsitem.headline: Another body found from July 17 TWA crash.

text.p: The remains of another victim of TWA Flight 800 have been recovered and identified, officials said on Friday.
The remains, found on Wednesday by Navy divers, bring the number of victims recovered to 214, the Suffolk County Medical Examiner's Office said. Of those, 213 have been identified.
All 230 people on board Flight 800 died when the Paris-bound Boeing 747 exploded in midair and crashed into the Atlantic Ocean off Long Island, New York, on July 17.

The latest remains, the first to be found in six weeks, were that of Eric Harkness, 23, of Norwalk, Ohio, the medical examiner's office said. The identification was made through the use of dental records, it said.
The cause of the disaster has not been determined. Investigators believe it was caused either by a bomb, a missile or a mechanical failure.
